articles.title: Dayton Schools Pay $78,650 for an AI Chatbot Named Jordan — But Research Lags Behind
articles.summary: A Dayton, Ohio, school district renewed a $78,650 contract for AI tools, including a chatbot named Jordan that acts moody so students give it advice. A Stanford review of 800+ papers found little evidence on how school AI affects kids.

articles.title: Maine's $300 Million Salmon Farm Paused, Blaming Trump's Tariffs
articles.summary: A $300 million salmon farm in Millinocket, Maine, was 80% complete when it paused indefinitely, blaming tariff uncertainty. Maine does $6 billion in annual trade with Canada — and Sen. Susan Collins faces a tight re-election race.

articles.title: Deadly Drone Wave Hits Kyiv, Including a Historic Science Academy
articles.summary: Russia launched about 120 drones across Ukraine on Monday, officials say. At least nine people were killed, and a drone struck Kyiv's National Academy of Sciences.
